maddeler.e:
استريثا (form X)
# اُسْتُرِيثَا (usturīṯā) /us.tu.riː.θaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
# اِسْتَرِيثَا (istarīṯā) /is.ta.riː.θaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
